Built on the same audio backbone as MOSS-Audio, MOSS-Music is further specialised on music via dedicated continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning — targeting musical captioning, lyrics ASR, structural analysis ...

sources.snippet: In this release, we provide two 8B models: MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct and MOSS-Music-8B-Thinking. The Instruct variant is optimised for direct instruction following on musical prompts, while the Thinking variant provides stronger chain-of-thought reasoning for musical analysis.
